mapper.insert: insert into local_message_outbox (idempotency_key, exchange_name, routing_key, payload_json, reliability_level, status, retry_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{idempotencyKey}, #{exchangeName}, #{routingKey}, #{payloadJson}, #{reliabilityLevel}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update local_message_outbox set status = #{sendingStatus}, update_time = now(), lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, error_message = null where id = #{id} and ( ( status in (#{pendingStatus}, #{failedStatus}) and (next_retry_time is null or next_retry_time <= #{now}) ) or ( status = #{sendingStatus} and (lease_until is null or lease_until <= #{now}) ) )

update local_message_outbox set status = #{sentStatus}, update_time = now(), sent_time = #{sentTime}, lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, next_retry_time = null, error_message = null where id = #{id} and status = #{sendingStatus} and lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}

update local_message_outbox set status = #{failedStatus}, update_time = now(), retry_count = ifnull(retry_count, 0) + 1, error_message = #{errorMessage}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, lease_owner = null, lease_until = null where id = #{id} and status = #{sendingStatus} and lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}

update local_message_outbox set status = #{pendingStatus}, retry_count = 0, error_message = null, update_time = now(), lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, next_retry_time = null, sent_time = null where id = #{id} and status = #{exhaustedStatus}
mapper.select: select count(*) from local_message_outbox where status = #{status}
